title: Home relay
description: The site as a postman between the pages of a person's modules (mail, calendar, ...) and that person's worker on the home server: requests and answers are end-to-end encrypted, the site keeps only ciphertext for at most a minute, and the home server alone decides which person, account and data a request reaches.
isolationReason: the worker is a systemd service of the home server under the person's own user (aiwb-<slug>); the site only carries sealed items

data.server: files: workers.json (sha256 of each environment's worker token), q/<env>/ sealed requests and answers kept only until taken (at most 60 s) and status.json (worker key, small status per module)
data.home: on the home server: /etc/home-relay/<slug>.env (environment, site route), /etc/home-relay/modules.d/<module>.json (handlers), /var/lib/home-relay/<slug>/relay-key.pem, credential home-relay.<slug>.cred
